chapter: Drum sets, small bands and the depression
title: Depression pay and the big bands of the day
summary: Sidney had more jobs than anyone; the most Jackson got was four dollars a night; many big bands then existed.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: The Depression years and the WPA band

blocks.x: Did Sidney get jobs always in that big band during the depression or were you with him during the depression? He got a lot of jobs.

But Sidney had more jobs than anybody else. He had the largest band around here and he was well known, well liked, and he was playing with the people like, so Sidney had more jobs than he could have at that time. Well, how much did they have to get for a date for one? Well, the most I got in Sidney's band for a night was four dollars. During the depression it was four dollars.
During the depression, that's what I wondered how people could afford to pay, you know. That's right. For such a big band of fifteen pieces would be. That's right.
During the depression, that was four, from three to four dollars.
Still for seventy-five or a dollars or so, I guess they could hire the band in for a night. That's right.
But if it was a depression now, you couldn't hire bands for what they pay a band. No.
But at that time, and that was a lot of money to us.

Yeah, there ain't right. That was a lot of money to us. That was a lot of money. When Sidney would hand me that four dollars, that was a lot of money. And we played, we played hard, we played good, we enjoyed playing. It was a wonderful time, doing that, um, Sidney's band. Then we started with the small combos, I started playing the small combos, I've been with that ever since. I don't know when I would go back to a big band again unless it would be a boom. The only big band I see anything happening within the world today is bands like Count Basie, Duke Ellington.
Yeah, there aren't very many big bands. There aren't many big bands. There aren't many big bands.
But at that time you had a lot of big bands. Sunset Royal, Entertainment, Jimmy Lutzfoot, Andy Quick, all those of them coming. Yeah, there were a lot of big bands at that time.
